gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-nag-mundari: Eye-catching and a bit retro, Vast Shadow cuts every stroke to one width and leaves generous room beside each letter. Noto Sans Nag Mundari's big lowercase meets it head on.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Vast Shadow draws a flat, unswelling line around every curve. Noto Sans Ogham sits beneath it with wide gaps in the e and bold-looking lowercase, thanks to tall bodies, so both hold their own.

gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Vast Shadow is built from tubular, wire-like letterforms, every stroke one width, with generous space on either side. It grabs attention; Noto Sans Rejang, with porthole-wide counters, simply reads well.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-runic: Vast Shadow shows no stroke modulation whatsoever, each letter cut to one width with plenty of room around it. Noto Sans Runic has a big x-height, plus curves that never close, so longer text stays open.
